data.body: AWS credentials available in this environment (profile frontier, us-east-2, IAM user joe_sec) — operator authorized local verification; only S7/S8 (review-bot IAM grant + prod cutover) need new credentials. Ran S3s caching measurement FOR REAL and folded the results into its plan, replacing speculation with data. Findings: (1) on-demand model ids are NOT invokable at all here (ValidationException, both modern and old models) so S3s on-demand-vs-profile comparison is moot — only inference profiles work; (2) us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 CACHES (cache_write=4017 then cache_read=4017, reproducible across runs via a warm 5-min TTL cache) which REFUTES pydantic-ai #4381s premise for this model/region; (3) caching is MODEL-dependent and fails SILENTLY — us. AND global. opus-4-5 both report cache_read=0 and cache_write=0 while billing the full 4029 input tokens, and a controlled same-model us-vs-global comparison REFUTED MY OWN first inference that the global. prefix was the cause; (4) Haiku 3 + cachePoint hard-fails AccessDenied. (5) NEW HIGH-SEVERITY not in the plan: temperature is FATAL on Bedrock for some models — us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 + temperature=0 returns 400 temperature is deprecated for this model, confirmed through pydantic-ai as ModelHTTPError 400, and _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings exists ONLY in pydantic-ais models/anthropic.py not models/bedrock.py, so the Anthropic path degrades with a warning and Bedrock hard-fails. rebar sets temperature whenever configured and its Pass-2 verifiers deliberately send temperature=0, so Bedrock gate runs would break — and this directly threatens eb6e (prod cutover, no fallback). Plan now carries three DECISIONS rather than open questions: default = us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; warn when caching requested but both counters zero (mirroring _warn_if_zeroed_usage); carry supports_temperature on f184s capability record with a Bedrock override entry and omit the parameter when withdrawn (rejected: dropping temperature on all Bedrock calls, which loses Pass-2 greedy determinism; and catch-400-and-retry, which burns a billable agentic call on model-specific error text). Also resolved the 3-vs-2 cache-key contradiction in favour of TWO keys for parity with the Anthropic path, and moved the builder to a NEW leaf src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py because providers.py is at 289 against a 300 cap that is an ATTESTED criterion of closed story 7468.
